OmegaZKSTARK.BlindingScheme:
Domain D = {g^0, ..., g^{N-1}} subset GF(p)*, g = primitive N-th root of unity. Coset = g0 * D where g0=7 not-in D. Vanishing poly Z_D(x) = x^N - 1. Z_D(g0*g^i) = (g0*g^i)^N - 1 = g0^N - 1 != 0 for all i. QED
Blinded trace: S_blind(g0*g^i) = S_i + Z_D(g0*g^i) * r_S -- r_S random per point E_blind(g0*g^i) = E_i + Z_D(g0*g^i) * r_E -- r_E random per point Z_D != 0 on coset: blinding is ACTIVE at every leaf. S_i and E_i are computationally hidden. QED (B1 fix)
